title: First round
text: Let $$u=x^2$$ and $$dv=sin\left(x\right) dx$$, so $$du=2x dx$$ and $$v=-cos(x)$$. This gives $$-x^2 cos\left(x\right)$$ plus the integral of $$2x cos\left(x\right)$$.

title: Second round
text: Use integration by parts again with $$u=2x$$ and $$dv=cos\left(x\right) dx$$. The integral of $$2x cos\left(x\right)$$ is $$2x sin\left(x\right)+2cos\left(x\right)$$.
